name: sentinel-rescue-x
description: SENTINEL RESCUE-X — simulación de rescate de astronautas con base de datos SQLite e IA de alerta (prototipo educativo).

scripts.test: node --check script.js && node --check i18n.js && node --check sw.js && node --check server.js && node --check threejs/scene.js && node --check scripts/gen-icon.js && node --check scripts/build-mobile.js
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run mobile:build && cap sync android
scripts.mobile:open: npm run mobile:sync && cap open android
scripts.mobile:apk: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
